contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CLA]VDIVS AVG ; R/ VIR[TVS AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP CLA]VDIVS AVG. Reverse description: Mars or Virtus standing right holding branch and spear, shield at feet. Reverse inscription: VIR[TVS AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 20.1mm, Weight: 2.32gms, die axis: 12
